description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news application. It manages tabbed navigation between different news categories by creating a TabBar and TabBarView with respective category widgets. It also includes navigation to a saved news screen and handles error display within the UI.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides the main interface with tabs for different news categories and navigation actions.

classes.name: _CategoryTabSpec
classes.description: A simple data class to associate a tab title with its corresponding widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including the AppBar, TabBar, and TabBarView, and manages error display.
